proceed with the plan: Even though it started to rain, the organizers decided to proceed with the plan and hold the concert outdoors.
雖然開始下雨了，主辦單位還是決定繼續進行計畫，在戶外舉辦音樂會。
proceed to the gate: After you pass through security, please proceed to the gate at least thirty minutes before your flight leaves.
通過安檢後，請在班機起飛前至少三十分鐘前往登機門。
proceed with caution: The road is icy and very narrow up the mountain, so all drivers should proceed with caution tonight.
上山的路結冰又非常狹窄，所以今晚所有駕駛都應該謹慎進行。
proceeds from the sale: The students gave all the proceeds from the sale of their cookies to a local animal shelter.
學生們把餅乾的銷售所得全部捐給了當地的動物收容所。
process information: Babies can process information much faster than we thought, especially when they hear familiar voices.
嬰兒處理資訊的速度比我們想像的快得多，尤其是在聽到熟悉的聲音時。
process an application: The bank usually takes about five working days to process an application for a new credit card.
銀行處理新信用卡的申請通常需要大約五個工作天。
process food: Many factories use salt and sugar when they process food, so it can stay on the shelves longer.
許多工廠在加工食品時會加入鹽和糖，讓食品可以在貨架上放得更久。
process data: Modern computers can process data from millions of users in just a few seconds.
現代電腦只需幾秒鐘就能處理數百萬名用戶的數據。
processing time: The processing time for a new passport is about two weeks, so apply early if you plan to travel.
新護照的處理時間大約是兩週，所以如果你打算出國，要提早申請。
proclaim independence: In 1776, the American colonies decided to proclaim independence from Britain and form a new nation.
1776年，美洲殖民地決定宣布脫離英國獨立，並建立一個新國家。
proclaim victory: It is too early to proclaim victory, because the votes from the largest city have not been counted yet.
現在宣告勝利還太早，因為最大城市的選票還沒有計算完畢。
proclaim a holiday: After the team won the world championship, the mayor decided to proclaim a holiday so everyone could celebrate.
球隊贏得世界冠軍後，市長決定宣布放假，讓大家都能慶祝。
proclaim one's innocence: Although the police found his car near the bank, the young man continued to proclaim his innocence in court.
雖然警方在銀行附近找到他的車，那名年輕人仍在法庭上持續聲明自己無辜。
produce results: If you study a little every day instead of only before exams, your hard work will produce results.
如果你每天讀一點書，而不是只在考前才讀，你的努力就會產生結果。
produce evidence: The lawyer failed to produce evidence that his client was at home on the night of the crime.
律師未能提出證據，證明他的委託人在案發當晚待在家裡。
produce a film: It took the young director three years and a lot of money to produce a film about her hometown.
這位年輕導演花了三年和大筆金錢，製作了一部關於她家鄉的電影。
produce a passport: The guard stopped the tourist, who reached into his back pocket to produce a passport with shaking hands.
警衛攔下那名遊客，他雙手顫抖地從後口袋裡出示護照。
produce an effect: Just ten minutes of exercise a day can produce an effect on your mood and help you feel happier.
每天只要運動十分鐘，就能對你的心情產生效果，讓你感覺更快樂。
profile a criminal: Experts study a person's behavior and habits to profile a criminal before the police know his name.
專家會研究一個人的行為和習慣，在警方得知犯人姓名之前就先側寫罪犯。
keep a low profile: After the scandal, the famous singer decided to keep a low profile and stayed away from parties for months.
醜聞爆發後，那位知名歌手決定保持低調，好幾個月都不參加派對。
a high-profile case: The murder of the rich businessman became a high-profile case that appeared on the news every night.
這名富商的謀殺案成了備受矚目的案件，每晚都出現在新聞上。
profile a company: Each month, the business magazine chooses to profile a company that has grown quickly in the past year.
這本商業雜誌每個月都會挑選一家在過去一年快速成長的公司來介紹。
profit from experience: Wise people profit from experience, so they rarely make the same mistake twice in their lives.
聰明的人會從經驗獲益，所以他們一生中很少犯同樣的錯誤兩次。
profit by one's mistakes: My coach says losing is fine as long as we profit by our mistakes and play better next time.
教練說輸球沒關係，只要我們能從錯誤中學習，下次打得更好就行。
profit from the crisis: Some shops tried to profit from the crisis by selling face masks at ten times the normal price.
有些商店試圖從危機中獲利，用正常價格的十倍販賣口罩。
turn a profit: The small café lost money in its first year, but it finally began to turn a profit last spring.
這家小咖啡館第一年虧錢，但去年春天終於開始獲利。
program a computer: My cousin learned to program a computer when he was twelve, and now he designs his own games.
我表哥十二歲時就學會為電腦編程，現在他自己設計遊戲。
be programmed to: This robot vacuum can be programmed to clean the living room every morning while we are at work.
這台掃地機器人可以被設定成每天早上在我們上班時打掃客廳。
program the thermostat: Before leaving for vacation, Dad decided to program the thermostat so the house would stay warm but not waste energy.
出發度假前，爸爸決定設定溫控器，讓房子保持溫暖又不浪費能源。
